_note: Per-class changes from official patch notes, verified against the note text. Rendered in Class at a glance and next to matching spell names. Wiki spell data (data/classes.json) is not edited; where it disagrees, see content/source_conflicts.json (manual).

Archer.label: FACT
Archer.text: Trap skill schematics now have a required level, so you can't buy one before you can use the ability.

Archer.label: FACT
Archer.text: Sniper's Blind no longer shares a cooldown with racial Hide abilities; a message now tells you when you've been in it long enough for the Piercing Strike ambush bonus (applies reliably after 3 s hidden).

Archer.label: FACT
Archer.text: Disengagement now applies its dethreat in a point-blank area around you, needs no target, and won't aggro non-aggressive NPCs.

Archer.label: FACT
Archer.text: Channeled abilities such as Strafing Barrage now start their cooldown when channeling starts.

Bard.label: FACT
Bard.text: Thunderous Vocalization base damage 38 → 42 (it was set to the previous tier's value; a fuller review is planned).

Bard.label: FACT
Bard.text: Unifying Anthem is no longer sold by merchants ("for now, anyway").

Bard.label: FACT
Bard.text: Deep Gnome Bard is coming soon (internal testing): not yet available.

Beastmaster.label: FACT
Beastmaster.text: New Beastmasters now start with Revive Companion and Call Companion scrolls.

Beastmaster.label: FACT
Beastmaster.text: Uninterruptible abilities such as Chop are no longer interrupted by taking hits (only stuns or kicks/bashes during the wind-up).

Cleric.label: FACT
Cleric.text: HP buff spells (Resilience, Resolution, Hymn of Resilience/Resolution): the top-up heal now equals the max HP buff exactly (500 at level 60) and no longer scales with Wisdom; refreshing on a recently buffed player refreshes the duration but skips the free heal.

Cleric.label: FACT
Cleric.text: Blessing of Devotion spells: the heal on cast no longer scales with Wisdom and matches the max HP increase; other effects unchanged.

Inquisitor.label: FACT
Inquisitor.text: Aura of Resistance now includes a 10% bonus to generated threat (like other tanks' defensive stance/aura).

Monk.label: FACT
Monk.text: Slow Breathing is no longer incorrectly flagged as outdoor-only.

Ranger.label: FACT
Ranger.text: Recuperate is out-of-combat only: it can't be cast in combat, party members in combat don't get it, and anyone who enters combat loses it. It has no other limits now.

Rogue.label: FACT
Rogue.text: Class trainers now train Lockpicking up to 10 skill.

Rogue.label: FACT
Rogue.text: Poisonous Spider Venom Sac can now be used in Poison Making.

Rogue.label: FACT
Rogue.text: A message now tells you when you've been in Stealth long enough for the backstab ambush bonus.

Rogue.label: FACT
Rogue.text: Sap no longer causes unintended threat.

Shadow Knight.label: FACT
Shadow Knight.text: Lord of Shadows now grants HP and its description lists the right stats; Shadow Strike now extends the Shadows line correctly; recasting the Palpitation DoT line now resets it instead of extending it.

Shadow Knight.label: FACT
Shadow Knight.text: Uninterruptible abilities such as Reave are no longer interrupted by taking hits.

Wizard.label: FACT
Wizard.text: Wizard Glyphs (the Glyph: spells) no longer cause unintended threat.
